comment: Inputs of scan.py. Git sources are read at the revision, never from the working tree.
excluded_stems_comment: Metadata files whose names the sources match only by accident: the C library's (stdint, intsafe limits), GDI+ C++ types named like ours (Point, Rect), and miniaudio backends compiled out by MA_ENABLE_ONLY_SPECIFIC_BACKENDS (dsound, mmeapi, ksmedia, winsock2; audioclient and mmdeviceapi sit under #if 0). The GPU headers d3d11 and dcomp are linked only by build-notes, which is not scanned; dxgi is gui_forms' (windows_vblank_clock.cpp, since cp37).
excluded_tokens_comment: C library names the metadata also carries (crt stream owns them), and macros miniaudio defines itself, then Plan Paint's own enumerators (Shape::Arc, Shape::Rectangle, AtlasKind::None), which the scan reaches through first-party includes; None would root a DXCore enum.
extra_roots_comment: Names the runtime stream's system_interim.h declares (queue/claude__windows-msvc-runtime.md, 'For the headers worker'), so windows.h can replace it. Then the names the hand-written stxwin_versionhelpers.h uses. Then the names libc++'s build needed (queue/claude__windows-own-crt.md, api_gaps.h). Then the names of STXlib branches not yet on the scanned revision: SetStdHandle (claude/stx-mcp, pipes), WaitOnAddress, WakeByAddressSingle and WakeByAddressAll (claude/threads-additions, atomic waits); LockFileEx, UnlockFileEx, the LOCKFILE_ flags, FILE_RENAME_INFO and the FILE_RENAME_FLAG_ constants (FileRenameInfoEx is an enumerator of FILE_INFO_BY_HANDLE_CLASS, already declared) (claude/settings-store, FileLock and the POSIX-semantics replace); the scan cannot take a later STXlib revision, whose committed api/include would feed the generated headers back into the scan. Then the names the 2026-11-24 rescan (gui_forms ad33e3d50, gui_forms_tests 0ef4f333, stx 1ed38f6, STXlib a8e27d6) no longer found, kept so that 1.0.0 removes no declaration the earlier headers had; drop them at a deliberate pruning: BN_CLICKED, COPYDATASTRUCT, CURSORINFO, CURSOR_SHOWING, CWP_SKIPDISABLED, CWP_SKIPINVISIBLE, CWP_SKIPTRANSPARENT, ChildWindowFromPointEx, CreateMutexW, FindWindowW, GCLP_HCURSOR, GR_USEROBJECTS, GUITHREADINFO, GWLP_HWNDPARENT, GetClassLongPtrW, GetCursorInfo, GetDlgItem, GetGUIThreadInfo, GetObject, GetQueueStatus, HTCLOSE, HTMINBUTTON, HTSYSMENU, HWND_BOTTOM, IMAGE_LOAD_CONFIG_DIRECTORY64, INPUT, INPUT_KEYBOARD, IsHungAppWindow, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, PostThreadMessageW, RegisterClassW, ReleaseMutex, SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG, SMTO_BLOCK, STM_GETICON, SendInput, SendMessageTimeoutW, SetParent, VK_ATTN, WAIT_ABANDONED, WM_COMMAND, WM_COPYDATA, WM_INPUT, WNDCLASSW, WS_CHILD, WS_DISABLED, WS_VISIBLE.
